title: Functorial embedding of a tower into a split tower with split cokernel
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Call an inverse system $(X_n,g_n:X_{n+1}\to X_n)_{n\geq1}$ in $\mathcal A$ [def-weil-inverse-system] *split* if every $g_n$ has a right inverse, i.e. there are $\sigma_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ with $g_n\circ\sigma_n=\mathrm{id}_{X_n}$. For an inverse system $T=(T_n,f_n)$ write $f_{m,n}=f_n\circ f_{n+1}\circ\cdots\circ f_{m-1}:T_m\to T_n$ for $m\geq n$ ($f_{n,n}=\mathrm{id}$), and let $E(T)$ be the inverse system with $E(T)_m=\prod_{n=1}^mT_n$ (a finite product) and transition maps $E(T)_{m+1}\to E(T)_m$ the projections forgetting the factor $T_{m+1}$; for a morphism $\varphi=(\varphi_n):T\to T'$ let $E(\varphi)_m=\prod_{n\le m}\varphi_n$. Let $j_T:T\to E(T)$ have components $j_{T,m}=(f_{m,n})_{n\le m}:T_m\to\prod_{n\le m}T_n$. Then $E$ is an additive functor from inverse systems in $\mathcal A$ to inverse systems in $\mathcal A$, $j_T$ is a morphism of inverse systems natural in $T$ (i.e. $E(\varphi)\circ j_T=j_{T'}\circ\varphi$), every $j_{T,m}$ is a monomorphism, and both $E(T)$ and the levelwise cokernel $C(T)=(\operatorname{coker}j_{T,m})_m$, with its induced transition maps, are split inverse systems.
